description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" measured across various language families for six different computational models. The horizontal category axis, labeled "family", displays language family groups including IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, arranged from left to right without a strict alphabetical or value-based sorting. The vertical value axis, labeled "effect", uses a linear scale with visible tick marks and corresponding grid lines at intervals of 10, ranging from below 10 to above 30. The bars are clustered into groups for each language family. Within each cluster, up to six distinct bars represent different models, as indicated by the legend in the upper right: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (dark red). Each bar features a black, I-beam style error bar extending vertically from its top edge to represent variance. The bar heights vary significantly across the categories; the tallest bars are observed in the Semitic category, where the light blue mBERT and light red mBERT-B2 bars extend well above the 30 mark, reaching approximately 35 to 40. Conversely, the shortest bars are found in the Isolate and Uralic categories, where all model bars remain near the baseline, with values approximately between 0 and 5. The entire chart is rendered with a skewed, rotated perspective, and no specific bars are otherwise visually emphasized.
